tc.name: Transport cube
tc.description: A grid utility that translates between endpoints and carries a detected rider by the same displacement. Its map cell owns the route and timing configuration.

sc.name: Scale cube
sc.description: A grid utility whose visible cube and collision grow together. Its map cell sets size limits, centre offset and optional deck seating.

rc.name: Rotation cube / bridge
rc.description: A grid utility with a rotating collision body. The map selects angles, axis and timing; the bridge profile makes a thin plank instead of the default wall.
